A '''starship''' was present in the [[Kolatill system/Legends|Kolatill system]], a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]],<ref name="Omens">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Omens|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref> in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> The [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was attacked around the same [[Time/Legends|time]] that the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|escort carrier]] ''[[Kathol Protector]]''&mdash;a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] serving in the [[Moff Sarne's forces|military forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]&mdash;[[Bombing of Domaz|attacked]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kolatill]]'s [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Domaz]]. The assault crippled the vessel, leaving it adrift between [[Unidentified planet (Kolatill system)|planets]]. The derelict was discovered by a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] patrol from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'', which was in-system responding to a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] from Kolatill. The [[Corvette/Legends|corvette's]] crew deployed a rescue team to investigate the wreck and see if any survivors were sealed in airtight sections or [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]].<ref name="Omens" />

==Behind the scenes==
The starship was mentioned in "[[Omens]]", a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying adventure]] included in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'', a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published in [[1995]]. The discovery of the ship is a possible side adventure that the players may undertake during the scenario. The players can search the ship for crew members that may still be alive, although whether they discover any is left to the discretion of the gamemaster.<ref name="Omens" />
